title: PolicyExplainParams
description: Params for policy.explain: the command line to explain, and the effect class the call classified as. The effect is the caller's because the backend has no run to ask here — a call's effect depends on the tool's declared reachable set, which the approval prompt was already told — and deriving a second answer would explain a decision nobody took.

command.description: The command line, exactly as the person is looking at it. The backend parses it with the SAME parser a run uses, so the explanation is of the reading the enforcement had.

effect.description: The effect class the call classified as. It must name a class the matrix has a row for: an effect outside the lattice has no row, so the evaluator would answer with the ask an absent row decides and a caller would read a typo as a policy decision.
